plugin_description: Now-playing bar widget and popup replacing the builtin ones; scrolls phone volume over KDE Connect.

lyrics_offset_ms.label: Lyrics sync offset (ms)
lyrics_offset_ms.description: Shift synced lyrics earlier (negative) or later (positive) to match playback. Applies everywhere lyrics show.

hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when nothing is playing
hide_when_no_media.description: Remove the widget from the bar when no player has media.

hide_album_art.label: Hide album art
hide_album_art.description: Show the title and controls only, no cover.

album_art_only.label: Album art only
album_art_only.description: Collapse to just the cover, hiding the title.

hide_artist.label: Hide artist
hide_artist.description: Show only the track title, not the artist.

artist_first.label: Artist before title
artist_first.description: Order the label as artist then title instead of title then artist.

title_scroll.label: Scroll long titles
title_scroll.description: When to marquee a title too long to fit.

show_progress.label: Show progress bar
show_progress.description: Draw a thin playback progress bar along the widget.

progress_above.label: Progress bar on top
progress_above.description: Put the progress bar above the title instead of below it.

art_size.label: Album art size
art_size.description: Cover art edge length, in pixels.

art_radius.label: Album art corner radius
art_radius.description: Cover art corner radius in pixels; 0 is square, high values round to a circle.

max_length.label: Max width
max_length.description: Widest the title area is allowed to grow, in pixels.

panel_show_album_art.label: Show album art
panel_show_album_art.description: Show the cover art at the top of the card.

panel_album_art_size.label: Album art size
panel_album_art_size.description: Cover art edge length in the card, in pixels.

panel_album_art_radius.label: Album art corner radius
panel_album_art_radius.description: Cover art corner radius in the card, in pixels; 0 is square, high values round to a circle.

panel_show_album.label: Show album name
panel_show_album.description: Show the album name under the track title.

panel_show_source_label.label: Show source
panel_show_source_label.description: Show which player is playing, e.g. the phone, under the track info.

panel_show_progress.label: Show progress bar
panel_show_progress.description: Show a draggable seek bar for the current track.

panel_show_time_labels.label: Show time labels
panel_show_time_labels.description: Show elapsed and total time under the seek bar.

panel_show_playback_controls.label: Show playback controls
panel_show_playback_controls.description: Show the previous, play/pause, and next buttons.

panel_show_lyrics.label: Show lyrics
panel_show_lyrics.description: Show a few lines of synced lyrics, centered on the current one, with a link to the full lyrics popup.

panel_lyrics_context_lines.label: Lyric lines each side
panel_lyrics_context_lines.description: Lines to show before and after the current one.

panel_show_full_lyrics_button.label: Show "Full lyrics" button
panel_show_full_lyrics_button.description: Show the button under the lyrics that opens the full lyrics popup.

panel_show_player_switcher.label: Show player switcher
panel_show_player_switcher.description: Show a dropdown to pick the active player when more than one has media.

lyrics_bar_hide_when_no_lyrics.label: Hide when no lyrics
lyrics_bar_hide_when_no_lyrics.description: Remove the widget from the bar when there's no current line to show.

lyrics_bar_show_current_line.label: Show current line
lyrics_bar_show_current_line.description: Show the current synced lyric line next to the icon.

lyrics_bar_max_length.label: Max width
lyrics_bar_max_length.description: Widest the lyric line area is allowed to grow, in pixels.

lyrics_panel_show_track_info.label: Show track info
lyrics_panel_show_track_info.description: Show the track title and artist above the lyrics.

ui.lyrics_not_found: No lyrics found for this track
